text:
anya: Quick sync — we need a clear split for post-launch work. Proposal: critical customer-impacting issues (crashes, data loss, major workflow block) go into a 1.0.1 hotfix; everything else (UX polish, perf tweaks, small feature gaps) goes into 1.1. Thoughts? @michael @sam

michael: I like that. Two asks: define "major workflow block" (how many users / severity) and set a hard cutoff for hotfix inclusion.

sam: For severity suggest: "blocks primary user path for >=5% DAU or any paying customer blocking signup/checkout". Cutoff: 48h before QA freeze for hotfix.

jordan: 48h is tight for investigations. Can we do 72h for non-crash issues, keep 48h for regressions/crashes? Also need ETA for engineering capacity.

lee: We can reallocate 2 devs + 1 on-call SRE for the hotfix window. Recommend single assignee per bug and a short triage board. Telemetry runbook needs update so rollback is smooth.

anya: Updated proposal:
- Hotfix (1.0.1) inclusion:
  - Crashes / data loss -> always hotfix
  - Regressions impacting core flow and >=5% DAU or blocking any paid customer -> hotfix
  - Security/compliance -> hotfix
- Cutoffs:
  - Regressions/crashes/security: up to 48h before deploy window
  - Non-crash but blocking core flow: up to 72h before deploy window
- Capacity: 2 devs + 1 SRE reserved

Triage rubric (quick):
- Severity: Crash/data loss (P0), Blocker core flow (P0/P1), Degradation (P1), Minor UX/perf (P2)
- Customer signal: Paying customer blocked (escalate), >5% DAU affected (escalate)
- Repro: deterministic > flaky
- Suggested owner: team owning the failing workflow

michael: +1. Add "risk_of_fix" (high/medium/low) so patches get extra QA if needed.

sam: +1. Batch low-risk small fixes into one hotfix chunk grouped by owner to reduce churn.

anya: I'll add "risk_of_fix" to the rubric and create a board flag: postlaunch-hotfix. Can someone make the board and link? @sam?

sam: Creating board now, ETA 30m. Will post link.

ops-bot: Deploy window for next hotfix candidates: 2024-05-10T02:00:00Z. Ensure triage/assignment before cutoff.

jordan: That timeline works. If customers report urgent issues, ping me to escalate to SRE.

anya: Customer comms: short note to customers on Friday explaining 1.0.1 plan and timelines. @michael to draft technical blurb.

michael: Will share WIP in #customer-commms by tomorrow morning.

Actions:
- sam: create triage board + link (30m)
- michael: draft technical blurb (tomorrow AM)
- lee: reserve 2 devs + 1 SRE for hotfix window
- jordan: escalation contact
- anya: publish schedule and rubric after EOD approval

Thanks :rocket:
